description: Secretary of the Governor Western Province - Minute of the Western Provincial Public Management Assistants's Service Amendment No. 01
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the service minute for Western Provincial Public Management Assistants' Service, specifically addressing public service recruitment criteria, examination procedures, promotion methods, and qualification requirements. It focuses on public sector service conditions, recruitment processes, and administrative procedures for provincial public servants, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover public service recruitment, service conditions, and administrative instructions.
